Meta.title: Onista Cake Shop
Meta.description: Signature cakes, handcrafted daily in Riyadh.

Hero.ring: Handcrafted daily · Patisserie · Riyadh · مخبز أونيستا · Est. 2019 ·

About.body: Onista began as a single oven and a stubborn belief: that a cake should taste as good as it looks. Today our pastry team laminates, tempers and pipes every piece in-house, using French butter, single-origin chocolate and saffron sourced from the souq down the road.

Tasting.title: Café tasting request
Tasting.subtitle: Tasting requests for cafés
Tasting.body: Stock your counter with cakes your guests will photograph. Tell us which pieces you'd like to try and our wholesale team will confirm your tasting box over WhatsApp, usually within the hour.
Tasting.perk1Text: Up to five items from our wholesale menu, boxed for your team.
Tasting.perk2Text: Complimentary drop-off within Riyadh, Jeddah and Khobar.
Tasting.perk3Text: Daily or weekly standing orders with flexible minimums.
Tasting.emptyMenu: The tasting menu is being refreshed. Please check back soon.
Tasting.doneBody: We've logged it for our wholesale team. Send the pre-filled message on WhatsApp to confirm your tasting slot.
